hypotheses.text: Peripheral neuropathy in SPAX8 is an atypical, low-frequency phenotypic expansion restricted to motor-predominant axonal involvement, rather than a primary demyelinating sensorimotor polyneuropathy.
hypotheses.rationale: Resolves the conflict between initial descriptions characterizing SPAX8 as lacking peripheral nerve pathology and Bereshneh et al. (2020), which documented peripheral axonal neuropathy presenting with wrist and foot drop in two siblings homozygous for NKX6-2 p.Phe167Leu. Demonstrating that peripheral involvement is exclusively axonal and rare clarifies why EMG/NCS is normal in most cohorts while accommodating verified peripheral deficits in isolated kindreds.

evidence.text: Bereshneh et al. (2020) identified a novel homozygous missense variant c.501C>G (p.Phe167Leu) in two siblings who exhibited wrist and foot drop due to peripheral axonal neuropathy confirmed by EMG/NCV, designating this as an expanded feature of SPAX8.

hypotheses.text: The presence of a frank demyelinating sensorimotor polyneuropathy on nerve conduction studies discriminates PLP1-related disorders (e.g., SPG2) and GJC2/PMLD1 from SPAX8, where peripheral myelination is conserved.
hypotheses.rationale: Because NKX6-2 is primarily critical for central oligodendrocyte maturation and CNS paranodal axoglial architecture, peripheral myelin remains intact; any reported peripheral neuropathy in SPAX8 is axonal, whereas PLP1 mutations frequently cause mild multifocal demyelinating peripheral neuropathy.

evidence.text: PLP1-related disorders can manifest spastic quadriparesis with ataxia and mild multifocal demyelinating peripheral neuropathy on neurophysiologic evaluation.

new_directions.question_text: What is the exact prevalence and electrophysiological profile of lower motor neuron/peripheral axonal involvement across all published SPAX8 cohorts?
new_directions.rationale: Quantifying how many confirmed SPAX8 cases have undergone systematic EMG/NCS will establish whether peripheral axonal neuropathy is a true low-penetrance feature or an under-ascertained late finding.

new_directions.question_text: Do specific missense variants in the homeobox or flanking domains of NKX6-2 correlate with distal axonal motor denervation versus pure central spasticity?
new_directions.rationale: Comparing variant locations between patients with wrist/foot drop (e.g., p.Phe167Leu) and those with pure upper motor neuron signs will clarify genotype-phenotype correlations.
